title: Psalms 125
paragraphs: ¹ Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever. ² As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forth and forever. ³ For the scepter of the wicked will not rest over the land given to the righteous, so that the righteous do not reach out their hands to do wrong. ⁴ Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart. ⁵ But as for those who turn to crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
